Sophia (Marketing): Draft landing blog is up: https://docs.internal/redwood/launch-blog-draft — TL;DR: product launch + benchmark highlights + webinar CTA. Need hero angle sign-off, CTA variants, legal on benchmark language, and routing for webinar signups. Can folks review by EOD Fri? Liam (PM): skimmed — love the narrative. Suggest moving the latency benchmark earlier (makes it more attention-grabbing). Also add a quick note comparing Dedicated vs Hosted for cost/latency. Nina (Design): saw it, thanks. Leaning toward Hero Option B (big chart + team photo). Will produce two crops for mobile/desktop by tomorrow. Oliver (Sales): Important: inbound routing needs to be explicit. Webinar signup should create HubSpot list "Launch-Webinar-Prospects" and trigger a qualification sequence. If company_size > 50, flag for SDRs. Also want clear CTA for "Request a demo" next to webinar CTA. Maya (Legal): Quick legal flag — benchmarking claims need sources and softening language (e.g., "up to" or "median" rather than absolute). Send me the raw numbers and test methodology and I'll add citations. Raj (Analytics): For tracking please add standard UTM and gclid support. Recommend: /webinar?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=launch_2026&utm_content=cta_A. Also add a hidden field 'origin=launch_blog' on the sign-up form for attribution. Sophia (Marketing): updated doc with hero B and moved latency para up. Added two CTA variants (short + long). Posting CTA snippets below — @Oliver confirm routing tag names. Sophia (Marketing): ``` CTA variant A (button): Join the live benchmark webinar — Reserve your spot CTA variant B (inline link): See the benchmarks & sign up for our webinar ``` Oliver (Sales): confirmed routing -> HubSpot list "Launch-Webinar-Prospects" and workflow name "marketing-webinar-2026". SDR auto-add if company_size>50. Also request an APAC-friendly webinar time option in the follow-up emails. Maya (Legal): added suggested sentence: "Benchmarks performed on representative workloads; results may vary. See methodology below." Marked two numbers to change to 'median' vs 'mean'. Grace (Design Ops): mobile hero crops look off with chart; will iterate and drop assets in #design-uploads by 6pm. Also recommend alt text for accessibility. Raj (Analytics): Suggest embedding the interactive benchmark graph with this snippet to reduce image reliance: ```
``` Sophia (Marketing): thanks — I've added the tracking params and the embed placeholder. Proposed publish window: Monday 09:00 PT, webinar Wed 14:00 PT. If legal + design are green by EOD Fri, we'll lock. calendar-bot: Event scheduled: "Redwood Launch — Live Benchmarks" on Wed 14:00 PT. Reminders set: 1d and 1h before. Oliver (Sales): FYI I'll prep a sales one-pager tied to the blog + webinar funnel. Will post in this thread when ready. Sophia (Marketing): perfect. Next steps: Nina finalizes hero assets, Maya posts minor legal tweaks, Raj confirms embed analytics, Oliver confirms routing. Publishing plan in doc header. :thumbsup:
